statement: Dial and randreg/randsp comparisons use executor case-index streams, not archived encounter streams; no soup-trajectory equivalence is claimed.
Single-pair C0 executor proofs cover all impact worlds. Direct sim_* lockstep coverage is plain/lethal L16/L32 only; the other soup-generating worlds lack that direct proof.

Final and labelled-emergence snapshots and frozen X input pools; scheduled intermediates excluded. Per-condition CP upper < 1e-4, no multiplicity correction; exploratory ring sweep excluded from decision.

Complete assay.assay score dictionaries for individually named Z80 genotypes and cited genotype-table entries, n=64 and seed=0. Budgets are 128, with the additional 32-step rows of the named Stage E unit table. Anonymous population/offset samples are aggregate claims, not named tapes. BFF is a separate ISA. Unspecified payloads use an explicitly labelled seed-0 tail; source-fixed payloads are retained. Same undefined (NaN) scores count as identical, without numeric tolerance.

The detached worker's initial catalogue omitted Stage E's named unit-tiling table. Those additional cases were completed locally with the same sealed assay engine and imp_* machines, in bounded bursts with equal-or-longer pauses. Source aliases identify table cases already covered by the Modal panel. The detached worker manifest remains immutable.

Latest propagating event in the frozen repaired replay, F/Q repaired coherently, exact class checks and first-probe reproduction. Every affected pair is attributed; no unaffected-pair census in the confirmatory run. An other event immediately stops execution.

Affected encounter memory or assay changes flag dependence on core semantics; this study does not determine whether evolved-soup headline outcomes change. C2 is a vendor variant. Second-tier replication requires explicit spend approval.
